source: stylesheet bodies read during live /, /idea/, /store/ and /help/ loads on jetbrains.com (same-origin stylesheet responses plus inline style blocks, re-parsed with CSSStyleSheet); resolved in a probe carrying the real sheets at 1440 x 900. No user theme switch; --rs-theme-dark is a page flag.
